I lost $18,000 because of one missing contract.
Here is the exact clause I now put in every single contract before any work starts, and I want you to copy it, because the version I used to send left the one thing that mattered completely open to interpretation.
Section 4. Payment on delivery, not on approval.
Approval is a feeling. Delivery is a date.
That one word change is worth $18,000 to me.
